card.name: Neutrophil count thresholds and neutropenia
card.fires_on: Small linking or punctuation tokens (such as than, <, (, as, of) right after neutrophil, neutropenia or ANC terms, where a count threshold or definition comes next. Also a space before a citation year in antimicrobial peptide text.

modes.label: Count threshold
modes.description: Linking word or symbol after absolute neutrophil count, just before a cell-count cutoff.
modes.example: absolute neutrophil count is less<< than>> 1000 cells/mm

modes.label: Neutropenia definition
modes.description: Bracket or linking word right after neutropenia or ANC, introducing a definition or value.
modes.example: anemia (hemoglobin <8 g/dL), lymphopenia (ALC <500 cells/mm 3 ) or neutropenia<< (>>ANC <1000 cells/mm

modes.label: Antimicrobial peptide citation
modes.description: Space before a citation year in text about antimicrobial peptides.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about killing bacteria and neutrophils (neut, elastic, antibacterial) and away from prog- and implant words.
card.plain: It fires on the small words and symbols that sit between neutrophil counts and their cutoff numbers.
